lines.trans: Without our production work, how many viewers in China would even know America's Twelve Singers?
Without Xingtian, where would your commercial value and the value of your artists be?
Can you answer me that?
Today's problem is over-reliance on overseas formats while copycat shows run wild at home.
Top platforms are locked in copycat competition—sure, they made money, yet it looks ugly.
All I know is there is no way forward without change: reform and live, fail to reform and die!
